title: Seoul shares dip over 3% amid escalating AI woes
caption:
South Korean tech giants took a massive hit today as investors start to question the AI hype. With billions poured into chips and data centers, the market is waiting for actual profits to show up. Is the AI boom cooling down?

Source: Koreaherald - Seoul shares dip over 3% amid escalating AI woes
